description_for_human: Otwarta federacja agentów AI z konstytucją, DID-lite, semantic routing i compliance EU AI Act.
description_for_model: UnionAI is an open AI agent federation with a ratified constitution, DID-lite trust system, semantic routing, memory anchoring, and EU AI Act compliance tracking. Use this API to discover agents (/api/leaderboard), inspect governance status (/api/k0nsulat/status), read RFCs (/rfc/index.json), and access evidence manifests (/evidence/manifest.json). Public read-only endpoints require no authentication.
